title: Today's top defense-tech headlines
big: 25 new stories since the last brief. The busiest areas: drones & air autonomy and maritime & undersea autonomy.

stories.h: F-16 radar upgrade contract passes $2 billion with new Northrop award
stories.what: Northrop Grumman won another $79.6 million from the U.S. Air Force for the radar going into its F-16 fleet, pushing a contract that started at $244 million in 2017 past the $2 billion mark. The award, announced Nov. 13 by the U.S.
stories.you: Better sensors and navigation that works without GPS are prerequisites for everything autonomous.

stories.h: Senate appropriators resuscitate Commerce space tracking program
stories.what: The Commerce Department effort was launched nearly a decade ago due to Defense Department concerns about the increasing drain on its space monitoring resources as commercial space traffic continues to skyrocket.
stories.you: More of the military's sensing and communications now runs through orbit, and new suppliers are getting in.

stories.h: U.S. Army adds a second drone to its battalion reconnaissance buy
stories.what: The U.S. Army awarded Kraus Hamdani Aerospace a $14.9 million contract “to procure Battalion Reconnaissance Unmanned Aircraft Systems,” according to a U.S.
stories.you: Drones are becoming the military's default purchase, so volume, price and reliability decide who wins.

stories.h: U.S. Navy switches next Growler jammer batch to extended-range version
stories.what: Raytheon will build the newest production batch of the U.S. Navy’s Next Generation Jammer Mid-Band pods in an extended-frequency version under a $42.1 million contract change the U.S. Department of War announced on Nov. 13.
stories.you: The Navy is short of ships and is turning to cheaper unmanned boats, which opens the door to new builders.

stories.h: Japan’s new air defense system spotted near Tokyo
stories.what: A military truck with no unit markings, seen on a highway outside Tokyo this week, may be the first public sighting of Japan’s new short-range air defense missile system, according to Japanese military enthusiasts on social media.
stories.you: Missile defense is one of the biggest budget lines this decade, and its software and sensors are open to newcomers.

watch.h: Stopgap funding expires: FY27 appropriations or another CR
